<definition_of_ready maturity="Sliced" cumulative="true">

Judge every criterion; this table includes the complete Proposed and Framed requirements and is the complete criterion set for Sliced Maturity, so apply no criterion outside it. Each criterion judges the record against the record rule it names in `<record_rules>`. A criterion's blocking status follows `review-bar`.

| ID                            | Criterion                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| ----------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `sliced-identity`             | `title`, `product`, `maturity: Sliced`, and `lifecycle` identify one intended Output, its owning Product or none for a root, and a valid Lifecycle under `record-shape`.                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `sliced-relationships`        | `predecessors`, `parent`, and `blocked_by` satisfy `lineage` and `blockers`, `blocked_by` names every known blocker, and the dependency graph has no blocker cycle.                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `sliced-intent`               | `## Intent` states What, Why, and Evidence under `intent`, with Observation present only where an observation gives rise to the Change.                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `sliced-input-boundary`       | The record satisfies `received-input-boundary`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `sliced-body-authority`       | The body satisfies `body-authority`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `sliced-governance`           | For a Leaf, `## Governance` lists every governing record with its verdict `in line`, `amended`, or `new` under `governance`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `sliced-governance-mutations` | For a Leaf, `## Governance mutations` holds a block for each amended or new record under `governance-mutations`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `sliced-spec-mutations`       | For a Leaf, `## Spec mutations` holds a block for each affected or intended Node, each opening with the Node's malleability before and after, in execution order under `spec-mutations`.                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `sliced-open-questions`       | `## Open questions` is empty or absent under `open-questions`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `sliced-slice`                | A Leaf's `## Slice` names the one repository and the one observable check of one coherent, independently integrable unit whose dependencies and sequence are resolved, under `slice`; a Parent is Sliced when every child exists naming it in `parent` and its record carries neither a Governance mutations nor a Spec mutations block, under `change-type`. |

</definition_of_ready>
